messages.english: This field-planting form belongs to an earlier checked batch. Check saved nursery batches before opening a new observation.
messages.translation: Fomu hii ya upandaji shambani ni ya kundi lililokaguliwa awali. Kagua makundi ya kitalu yaliyohifadhiwa kabla ya kufungua uchunguzi mpya.

messages.english: Record observed field planting from this nursery batch
messages.translation: Rekodi upandaji shambani ulioonekana kutoka kundi hili la kitalu

messages.english: Record only the plants you observed being planted in the assigned growing space. This does not deduct nursery stock, establish survival or mark the planned batch complete.
messages.translation: Rekodi tu mimea uliyoona ikipandwa katika nafasi ya ukulima iliyotengwa. Hii haipunguzi akiba ya kitalu, haithibitishi kuishi kwa mimea wala kuashiria kundi lililopangwa kuwa limekamilika.
Siku iliyopangwa kuingia shambani (UTC):

messages.english: This is the saved plan reference, not the day you observed the planting.
messages.translation: Huu ni rejeleo la mpango uliohifadhiwa, si siku uliyoona upandaji.

messages.english: DEMO — this observation stays in the sample session.
messages.translation: DEMO — uchunguzi huu unabaki katika kipindi cha mfano.

messages.english: Checked labels to snapshot with this observation; they do not verify seed identity:
messages.translation: Lebo za kundi lililokaguliwa kunakiliwa na uchunguzi huu; hazithibitishi utambulisho wa mbegu:
Siku halisi iliyoonekana
Ulichoona
Mimea uliyopanda

messages.english: Enter a whole count. An explicitly entered 0 is zero; a blank field is not a count.
messages.translation: Weka idadi kamili. Nambari 0 iliyoandikwa wazi ni sifuri; sehemu tupu si idadi.

messages.english: This record does not imply a particular earlier sowing or count, or change forecasts, task ticks or sales.
messages.translation: Kumbukumbu hii haimaanishi upandaji mbegu au hesabu maalum ya awali, wala haibadilishi utabiri, alama za kazi au mauzo.

messages.english: I confirm this day, note and planted count describe what I observed.
messages.translation: Nathibitisha kuwa siku hii, dokezo na idadi ya mimea iliyopandwa vinaeleza nilichoona.
Inarekodi upandaji shambani…
Hifadhi uchunguzi wa upandaji shambani
Rekodi upandaji mwingine wa shambani

messages.english: Stored nursery field planting evidence needs review. Its count and reference labels are withheld; retained evidence has not been treated as an ordinary unlinked note.
messages.translation: Ushahidi uliohifadhiwa wa upandaji shambani kutoka kitaluni unahitaji ukaguzi. Idadi yake na lebo za marejeleo hazionyeshwi; ushahidi uliohifadhiwa haujachukuliwa kama dokezo la kawaida lisilounganishwa.
Upandaji shambani uliorekodiwa

messages.english: Plants planted during this recorded work
messages.translation: Mimea iliyopandwa wakati wa kazi hii iliyorekodiwa
Siku iliyoonekana
Kuingia shambani kulikopangwa (tarehe ya kalenda ya UTC)
Aina ya mmea wakati wa uchunguzi
Rejeleo la fungu la mbegu wakati wa uchunguzi
Rejeleo la kundi la kulelea miche wakati wa uchunguzi

messages.english: Grower-entered observation for this work, not a stock balance, survival result or completed batch. Stored labels do not verify seed identity or identify a particular earlier sowing or count record.
messages.translation: Uchunguzi uliowekwa na mkulima kwa kazi hii, si salio la akiba ya mimea, matokeo ya kuishi au kundi lililokamilika. Lebo zilizohifadhiwa hazithibitishi utambulisho wa mbegu wala kubainisha rekodi mahususi ya awali ya upandaji mbegu au kuhesabu.
Rekodi upandaji shambani
